items.title: DTCC advances Collateral AppChain for tokenized collateral
items.summary: DTCC positions its Collateral AppChain as production infrastructure supporting tokenized securities, stablecoins and money-market funds as mobilizable collateral across jurisdictions.
items.implication: Improves path for tokenized MMFs into institutional collateral workflows.

items.title: ISDA assesses tokenized MMFs under the CSA
items.summary: ISDA paper examines how tokenized money-market fund shares may be posted under existing CSA language and identifies areas for potential standardized amendments.
items.implication: Reduces legal friction for bilateral collateral use of tokenized funds.

items.title: Ondo USDY remains among largest tokenized USD products
items.summary: USDY continues to rank among the largest tokenized USD products by distributed value, with leadership rotating among USDY, USYC, BENJI and BUIDL.
items.implication: Confirms sustained demand for yield-bearing cash alternatives.

items.title: Tokenized Treasuries hold near $14B with shifting leadership
items.summary: Total distributed value remains near $14B across more than 100 assets. Product count continues to rise while absolute AUM has been roughly flat to slightly lower from September peaks.
items.implication: Category is maturing; individual fund flows matter more than headline totals.
